title: Federal Reserve Board - Federal Reserve Board approves final rule to implement changes to market risk capital rule
主要内容: The Federal Reserve Board approved a final rule to implement changes to the market risk capital rule, requiring banking organizations with significant trading activities to adjust their capital requirements to better account for market risks. The rule incorporates revisions from the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision between 2005 and 2010. It aims to improve risk capture, reduce procyclicality, enhance sensitivity to risks, and increase transparency through disclosures. The rule excludes aspects of the Basel Committee's market risk framework that rely on credit ratings. Instead, it introduces alternative standards of creditworthiness for determining specific risk capital requirements for certain debt and securitization positions. These standards align with the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act, which requires federal agencies to remove references to and reliance on credit ratings. The rule applies to bank holding companies and state-chartered banks in the Federal Reserve System. It becomes effective on January 1, 2013.
